answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the garden of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Work waits on the spiral until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the orchard of the next round.
